lesson_intro.heading: CSA L1 · Logs and correlation
lesson_intro.board_text:
Logs Insights for L1
• Log group → streams → events
• Basic query: fields / filter / sort / stats
• Correlate: alarm time → logs → CloudTrail if IAM

You turn a red alarm into a narrative.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: An alarm without logs is a siren without a story. Today — log groups, a basic Insights query, and how you correlate alarm time with log lines. That is L1 incident literacy.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Minimal Insights query
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /ERROR/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 20

Habit: set the time range to the alarm window first.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: You do not need every Insights function. fields, filter, sort, limit — enough to find ERROR lines in the alarm window.

segments.title: Log groups then Insights
segments.setup_voice: Start from log groups — know which app writes where.

steps.voice: Logs Insights — pick the group, set time range to the alarm, run a filter for ERROR.

segments.lesson_voice: Wrong log group wastes the whole ticket. Confirm the service name Finova uses in the group path.

check.voice: Why set the Insights time range to the alarm window before querying?
check.response_if_correct: Correlation — you only want lines near the breach, not the whole week.
check.response_if_incorrect: The alarm told you when — how does that constrain the query?

steps.voice: Alarm fires on CPU — open dashboards to confirm the spike shape.
Then Insights for ERROR or timeout messages in that window.
If the log says AccessDenied on S3 — you already know the IAM playbook from last track.

check.voice: Alarm → graph → logs → ?  What do you open if logs show AccessDenied?
check.response_if_correct: IAM — principal and policies — and CloudTrail if you need who changed them.
check.response_if_incorrect: AccessDenied is an identity problem — which service?

segments.title: Open log groups
segments.completion_voice: Good. Know the group before you query.

segments.title: Synthesis
segments.question: Write the four-step L1 correlation chain from alarm to root-cause hypothesis.
segments.response_if_correct: Alarm → confirm on dashboard → Insights in the time window → IAM/CloudTrail if AccessDenied — then hypothesis.
segments.response_if_incorrect: Start from the page, then prove it with a graph and a log line.

session_close.ren_voice: Log group, time window, filter ERROR, correlate back to IAM when needed. That closes CSA L1 learning — console, IAM support, monitoring. Workspace tickets come next when we build them.

doubt_session.ren_response_template: Cover log groups, basic Insights, and alarm correlation. Defer subscription filters and OpenSearch.
doubt_session.ren_closing: CSA L1 learning track complete. You are ready for Finova-style tickets when workspace opens.
